text: 7. OVERDOSAGE 7.1 Signs and symptoms 7.2 Treatment The symptoms of overdosage of clidnium bromide are excessive dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary hesitancy and constipation, which are caused by antichollnergic actions. Treatment: Chlordiazepoxide hydrochloride overdosage symptoms include drowsiness, confusion, coma and diminished reflexes. Call your doctor or local poison control center if oversdosage is suspected.
